This week at the Scottish Open, McIlroy will be competing in front of a home crowd at Royal Portrush for the first time since he secured his long-sought Green Jacket, a victory that Clarke argues propels him to the rank of the greatest athlete from Northern Ireland.

Rory McIlroy from Holywood is considered one of the favorites for The Open, while Shane Lowry from Ireland aims to secure a victory in Portrush, similar to his triumph in 2019 when the championship last took place in the coastal town.
McIlroy is vying to regain the Scottish Open title he won in 2023 and head to his homeland on a high after enduring fluctuating form in the wake of the Masters.
